task.summary: Speed up Compare() in the stringlabels-tagged labels implementation by streamlining the back-scan loop that locates which label entry holds the first differing byte, without changing comparison results.
task.instructions: Optimize the model/labels package (stringlabels build tag) for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkLabels_Compare measures it; existing tests must still pass. Build and test with -tags stringlabels.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test -tags stringlabels passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: Compare() in labels_stringlabels.go re-scans label entries with a loop that re-runs decodeSize from index 0 each iteration and breaks via an inner conditional, adding overhead on the hot label-comparison path.

ops_fault.description: Label-set comparison in the stringlabels build shows time spent in Compare()'s back-scan loop in model/labels/labels_stringlabels.go, which decodes entry sizes to find which label holds the first differing byte.
localization_keywords: find entry holding first differing byte
repair_keywords: hoist decodeSize out of loop condition

visible_context.issue_text: Comparing two Labels sets via Compare() in the stringlabels implementation is slower than necessary because the loop that locates the differing label entry re-decodes sizes with an awkward break structure.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization PR #13782; loop in Compare() restructured to avoid redundant decoding.
